fato_historico: 1942: World War II: A Japanese floatplane drops incendiary bombs on Oregon.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how the embers of the past can transform into guiding beacons. Just as nature recovers from unexpected sparks, you may find that your sturdy Capricorn spirit possesses a rare, enduring strength. It is a good time to build upon your progress, letting your professional ambitions bloom with the quiet grace of a field of four-leaf clovers.
frase_do_dia: True strength rises from the ashes of yesterday to build a brighter tomorrow.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of abundance and your natural leadership abilities.
conselho: Trust your steady pace; slow and deliberate steps lead to the greatest rewards.
